speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: asked the Minister for Education (Schools) with more families moving into HDB BTO flats in Yishun (a) how will the Ministry ensure that there will be sufficient vacancies in neighbourhood Primary schools to meet the increased demand; and (b) what assistance is available to help new residents' children enrolled into a nearby school.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: MOE has always been assisting families which had a change of address to transfer schools throughout the academic year.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: If parents prefer to directly approach the school they would like to transfer their children to, they could do so at other times of the year.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: In such situations, we seek parents' understanding to consider other Primary schools near their residential address.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Yes, residents approached schools in Yishun to transfer their children from other parts of Singapore when they shifted into Yishun.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: They could not get it and then they approached the Member of Parliament, the Member has experienced problems.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Because we found out that the schools in Nee Soon South currently are unable to take in any student in Primary 2, in particular.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Because now, only about half has shifted in.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: There will be another half shifting in progressively over the next one year.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: As I have said earlier, there are available schools and places to accommodate all the transfer cases in Yishun.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: However, there are certain schools that, as mentioned by Er Dr Lee Bee Wah, may only be able to take in students at certain levels.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: From our correspondence with Er Dr Lee Bee Wah as well as the residents, we have placed a few of these students who have made requests to transfer schools due to a change of address.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Some are very appreciative, while others may have their own choices.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: However, we seek parents' and Members' understanding that, at times, we may need to facilitate to transfer them to a school that is maybe their second or third preferred choice.
